name: Brote
owner: A brand invented for this lab: an indoor plant nursery
idea: The “o” in brote is a pot: every plant grows out of it, with its own care card.
place: An indoor plant nursery: pots, deliveries and care cards

moss.name: Moss
moss.use: The second leaf of each plant

display.role: Round headlines with weight and charm

text.sample: Water once a week, give it indirect light and a pot that drains well.

grid: The “o” is the pot: its circle is the measure of the whole logo.
Each leaf is where two equal circles cross; the small one is three quarters the size.
The stem follows the axis of the “o”. Clear space: half an “o” on every side.

alt.logo: Brote logo: the word brote, its “o” a pot with a sprout growing out of it
alt.secondary: One-line version: the logo and the tagline indoor plant nursery
alt.submark: Brote symbol: a round pot with its two-leaf sprout
alt.patterns: Three patterns: foliage with seeds, pots with sprouts and terracotta scales
alt.post: Sample post: the plant of the week, a pothos with its three care notes
alt.story: Sample story: the care card of a calathea
alt.poster: Sample poster: a Saturday cutting swap, with one giant plant
alt.print: Sample stake for the pot, carrying the care card of a ficus
alt.object: Terracotta pot in 3D with its paper label and the plant seen from above

source: Brote is a brand exercise from the lab: logo, colours, patterns and pieces were drawn for this board. Its typefaces, Bricolage Grotesque and Figtree, are open-licence.
